subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Summary The Titanic was an American ship which was considered the greatest of all ages. It carried a lot of passengers but sank on its first voyage. It stuck with an iceberg. There were not enough life boats for all the passengers. It was a sad event in the history of travelling.
